originalTitle: Kenya cult leader's children still being starved weeks before trial, son says
title: Helping Kids in Kenya Get Food!
content:
Jambo, my amazing friends! That means 'hello' in Swahili, a language spoken in a super special country called Kenya, right here in beautiful Africa. Kenya is a place with amazing animals like giraffes and elephants, and sunny skies. But today, I have some news about some children in Kenya who need our thoughts and wishes for safety and yummy food. Sometimes, even in wonderful places, sad things happen, but brave people help make things better!

Kids Need Food to Grow Strong!

Imagine playing your favorite game, running around, or learning new things at school. To do all that, your body needs lots and lots of good food, doesn't it? Like tasty fruits, warm ugali (a popular Kenyan dish!), and fresh vegetables. But right now, some children in Kenya are not getting enough food. This makes them feel very, very hungry, weak, and sad. They are not eating properly, and that's called being 'starved'. It's a very serious problem because food helps our bodies grow big and strong, and helps our brains learn new things. Did you know? Eating healthy food helps you have enough energy to play all day long!

What's Happening?

There is a grown-up man who used to tell many people what to do and what to think. Sometimes, grown-ups like this are called 'cult leaders'. This man told people not to eat, and it made many people, especially children, very sick and hungry. It's very important to remember that all grown-ups should make sure children are safe, happy, and have enough to eat and drink. This man is going to have a special meeting soon, called a 'trial', where other grown-ups will talk about what happened and decide what is right and fair for everyone.

A Brave Son Speaks Up

Now, here's a very brave part of our story! The man who told people not to eat has a son. His name is Dan Mackenzie. At first, Dan tried to understand what his dad was doing. But then, Dan saw that his own brothers and sisters, his dad's children, were not getting food. They were feeling hungry and sick, just like the other children. Dan knew in his heart that this was not right. He knew that children must always have food and be safe. Did you know? It takes a lot of courage to speak up when you see something wrong, even if it's someone you know! So, Dan did something incredibly brave. He went to the grown-ups who help keep everyone safe, like the police and other leaders. He told them what was happening. He even had to tell on his own grandmother because she was also part of the group that was not helping the children get food. It must have been very hard for Dan to do this, but he knew it was the right thing to do to help his family and the other children.

Why is this Important?

Every child in the world, including you and all the children in Kenya, deserves to be safe, loved, and have plenty of yummy food to eat. When children are hungry, they can't play, they can't learn, and they can't be happy. It's like trying to make a car go without petrol – it just can't work! Grown-ups have a big job to protect children and make sure they have everything they need to grow up strong and healthy. Did you know? Kenya is famous for its long-distance runners who need super healthy food to be so fast!

What Happens Next?

Soon, the man who told people not to eat will go to his 'trial'. This is a very serious meeting where important grown-ups will listen to everyone and make decisions to keep children safe. Because Dan was so brave and told the grown-ups, help is now coming for the hungry children. Other kind grown-ups are working hard to make sure these children get the food they need and feel safe again. We hope that all the children will soon be eating yummy food and playing under the warm Kenyan sun. It's a reminder that it's always good to tell a trusted grown-up – like a parent, teacher, or guardian – if you ever see someone who is not safe or not getting what they need. Because together, we can all help make Africa, and the whole world, a safer and happier place for every child! Keep shining bright, little stars! Asante sana (thank you very much) for listening!

originalTitle: Residents warned not to drink tap water after hundreds fall sick near South Africa capital
title: Uh-Oh! Dirty Water Makes Kids Sick in South Africa!
content:
Hello, my wonderful friends all across Africa! Your friend, the news reporter, is here with some important news. Let's learn about something important that happened in South Africa.

Something Sad Happened

Close to a big city in South Africa, called Pretoria, something sad happened recently. Many people felt very sick. More than 400 people got sick from drinking water.

Mostly Little Ones

Most of the people who got sick were children, just like you! That made everyone very worried. They had tummy aches and felt unwell because of the water.

Why Did They Get Sick?

They got sick because they drank water that was not clean. It was dirty water. We call this "contaminated water." It means it had tiny, tiny things in it that can make you sick.

What Are These Tiny Things?

These tiny things are called germs. You cannot see germs with your eyes. They are super small, like invisible mini-monsters! Some germs are good and help us, but some are bad and can make you ill.

Germs in Water

Sometimes, bad germs get into our drinking water. When we drink this water, the germs go into our tummies. Then they can make us feel very poorly.

Drinking Tap Water

The people who got sick drank water from their taps. Tap water usually comes from big pipes and is safe to drink in most places. But this time, something went wrong with the water.

A Warning for Everyone

So, the grown-ups who look after the city gave a warning. They told everyone, "Please do not drink the water from your taps right now!" This was to keep more people from getting sick.

What to Drink Instead?

If tap water is not safe, what can people drink? They can drink water from a bottle that you buy in a shop. Or, they can drink water that has been boiled.

What is Boiling Water?

Boiling water means making it very, very hot. You put water in a pot on a stove until it makes big bubbles. This heat makes the water safe because it kills all the bad germs!

Did You Know?

Did you know that water covers most of our Earth? It's super important for all living things, from tiny ants to giant elephants and even us!

Why Boil Water?

After the water boils for a little bit, it becomes safe to drink again. You let it cool down, and then it's good to go! It's a special trick to make water clean when it's not safe.

Grown-ups Are Helping

Many grown-ups are working very hard to fix the problem. They are checking all the water pipes and where the water comes from. They want to find out how the bad germs got into the water.

Making Water Safe Again

They are working at places called water treatment plants. This is where water is cleaned very carefully before it comes to your tap. They are making sure the water gets super, super clean there.

Doctors and Nurses

Doctors and nurses are helping all the children and grown-ups who got sick. They are giving them medicine and making sure they feel better soon. We are thankful for them!

How to Stay Healthy

Even when water is usually safe, it's always good to wash your hands often. Use soap and water! Especially before you eat and after you use the toilet. This helps keep germs away from your body.

Did You Know?

Did you know that washing your hands properly can get rid of millions of germs? It's like having tiny superpowers that protect you!

Clean Water is Important

Clean water is super important for everyone. It helps us stay strong and healthy. We need it for drinking, cooking our food, and washing ourselves.

Our Bodies Need Water

Our bodies are made mostly of water! That's why we need to drink clean water every day to keep our bodies working well. It helps us run, play, and learn amazing new things!

Hope for Everyone

We hope that all the people who got sick feel better very, very soon. We also hope the helpers can make the tap water safe again very quickly for all the families.

Did You Know?

Did you know that you can get water from different places? Like from big rivers, lakes, or even deep underground! Then it needs to be cleaned for us to drink.

Let's All Be Careful

So, let's all remember to be careful. Always ask a grown-up if the water is safe to drink. And keep washing those hands with soap and water!

Good News Coming Soon

We will bring you more good news when the water is safe for everyone in South Africa again. Until then, stay safe, drink clean water, and keep smiling, my friends!
summary: Many children and grown-ups near Pretoria, South Africa, got sick from drinking dirty tap water, and now everyone is told to drink boiled or bottled water to stay safe.
whyMatters: This is important because everyone needs clean water to stay healthy and strong, and we must learn how to keep ourselves safe from germs in water.

originalTitle: Morocco's first female prime minister caught between the king, clerics, and feminists
title: A Super Special Lady Leads in Morocco!
content:
Hello from Africa!

Welcome, amazing kids, to your news from our wonderful continent, Africa! Today, we have a very special story about a very special lady. Her name is Fatima El Mansouri. She is from a beautiful country called Morocco. Fatima has a super important new job! She is the very first woman to be a Prime Minister in Morocco. Isn't that exciting?

Meet Fatima El Mansouri!

Fatima El Mansouri is a clever and kind lady. She has worked hard all her life. Now, she gets to help lead her whole country! Imagine being the first person ever to do something so big and important. She is like a trailblazer, making a new path for others to follow. Many people are very happy and proud of her.

Where is Morocco?

Morocco is a lovely country in North Africa. It has beautiful beaches, big mountains, and old cities. People there speak Arabic and French. It's famous for its delicious food and colorful markets! Morocco is a place with lots of history and amazing culture. Did you know? Morocco is very close to Europe, just across a small sea! That means it has connections to many different parts of the world.

What Does a Prime Minister Do?

A Prime Minister is like a very important helper for the country's main leader. In Morocco, the main leader is the King. The Prime Minister helps make sure the country runs smoothly. They help with schools, hospitals, and making sure everyone has what they need. It's a bit like being the head prefect of a very, very big school! They work hard to solve problems and make life better for everyone.

A Special Day for Girls and Women

When Fatima became Prime Minister, it was a huge day for all the girls and women in Morocco. It showed them that they can dream big! It showed them that they can do any job they want, even the most important ones. It's like seeing a girl become the captain of a football team when only boys used to play. It gives everyone hope and courage.

The Big Challenge for Fatima

Now, Fatima has a big and important job, but it's also a bit tricky. She has to work with different groups of people who sometimes have different ideas. It's like when you and your friends all want to play different games, and you have to find a way for everyone to have fun. Fatima is 'caught between' these different ideas.

The King of Morocco

First, there is the King. In Morocco, the King is a very powerful leader. He makes many big decisions for the country. He has special rules and ways of doing things that are very old and important. Fatima must work closely with the King and respect his ideas. Did you know? Morocco is one of the oldest kingdoms in the world! Their royal family has been leading for a very, very long time.

Religious Leaders

Then, there are the religious leaders. These are wise people who teach about their religion, Islam. They help people understand what they believe is right and wrong. Some religious leaders have special ideas about what women should and shouldn't do. Fatima needs to listen to their thoughts and ideas too. Did you know? Islam is a religion followed by many people in Africa and all over the world. It teaches about peace, kindness, and helping others.

Friends for Girls and Women

And finally, there are people who really want girls and women to have the same chances as boys and men. We call these people 'feminists' – but in simple words, they are friends who want fairness for all. They believe girls should go to school, choose their own jobs, and have a strong voice in everything. They want women to be able to do anything a man can do. Did you know? Around the world, there are many people working to make sure girls can go to school and follow their dreams, just like boys!

What are 'Women's Rights'?

'Women's rights' means giving girls and women fair chances. It means they should be treated equally. This means they can choose to go to any school, choose any job, and speak their minds. It means they should be safe and happy. Fatima's big job is to help advance these rights. 'Advance' means to help them grow and get better. She wants to make sure girls and women in Morocco have more fair opportunities.

Making Everyone Happy?

It's very hard to make everyone happy when they have different ideas! Fatima has to listen to the King, to the religious leaders, and to the people who want fairness for women. She needs to find a way to help women, but also respect old traditions and beliefs. It's like being a super-skilled juggler, keeping all the balls in the air at the same time!

Fatima's Big Hope

Fatima hopes to help girls and women in Morocco get better chances. She wants them to go to good schools, have good jobs, and feel strong. She knows it won't be easy because of the different ideas. But she is brave and determined. Her being Prime Minister already shows that big changes are possible!

Why This Matters to All of Us

This story is important because it shows us that girls and women can be great leaders. It shows us that even when things are tricky, brave people can try to make things better for everyone. When one woman succeeds, it helps all women and girls feel stronger and more hopeful. It teaches us about fairness and trying our best.

A Bright Future

We hope Fatima El Mansouri will do a wonderful job as Prime Minister. We hope she can help many girls and women in Morocco reach for the stars. She is a shining example for all of Africa and the world! Keep watching this space for more exciting news!
summary: Fatima El Mansouri is the first woman to become Prime Minister in Morocco, and her big job is to help advance women's rights while balancing the ideas of the King, religious leaders, and people who want fairness for girls.
whyMatters: This is important because it shows that women can be powerful leaders, gives hope to girls, and teaches us about being fair to everyone, even when different groups have different ideas.

originalTitle: ‘Horizontal revolt’: Why Albania’s young protesters want PM Rama to go
title: Big Voices from Young Hearts in Albania!
content:
Hello from Sunny Africa!

Hi everyone! Your friendly news reporter from Africa is here! Today, we're going on an adventure to a country far away called Albania. It's in a place called Europe, which is a big continent, just like Africa! Imagine a country like a very, very big family or a huge school. It has leaders, just like your family has parents or your school has a head teacher. These leaders help make rules and decide what happens in the country, like building roads or making sure schools are good.

Did you know? Albania has beautiful tall mountains, like giant green castles, and sunny beaches where the sea sparkles! It's a wonderful place with lots of history.

Who is Mr. Rama?

In Albania, the main leader is called the Prime Minister. His name is Mr. Edi Rama. He has been the leader for a long time, helping to run the country. Think of him like the main boss for the whole country. He helps decide about schools, hospitals, roads, and many other things that affect everyone who lives there, from babies to grandmas and grandpas.

Young People Have Something to Say!

Now, sometimes, people in a big family or a big school might feel like things could be better. Maybe they want more fun things to do, better playgrounds, or feel like their ideas are not being heard by the grown-ups in charge. Well, in Albania, a lot of young people – like your older brothers and sisters, or even college students – feel this way about their country and how it is being run.

They feel that things are not as good as they could be for their future. They want better jobs for when they grow up. They want their towns to be cleaner and safer places to live and play. And most importantly, they want their voices and ideas to be listened to by the grown-ups who lead the country, because their future is important!

Did you know? Even though they are young, their ideas are very important for the future of their country! Young people often have fresh, new ideas.

What is a "Protest"?

When many people feel the same way about something and want a change, they sometimes gather together. They might hold colourful signs with messages, sing songs, or march peacefully in the streets to show everyone how they feel. This special way of speaking up is called a "protest." It's like a big, peaceful way of saying, "Hey! We want things to be different! Please listen to us and help make things better!"

Imagine if all the students in your class wanted a longer break time to play outside. You might all decide to ask your teacher together, politely but firmly, explaining why it's a good idea. That's a bit like a protest, but for a whole country! It's about teamwork and speaking with one voice.

Did you know? Protesting peacefully is a way for people to use their voices to ask for changes without fighting or being unkind. It's about using words and actions, not anger!

Why Are Young People in Albania Protesting?

The young people in Albania are gathering because they want Mr. Rama, their Prime Minister, to leave. They believe that if he leaves, new leaders might come who will make better changes for everyone in Albania. They dream of a future where they have many opportunities to learn and grow, good schools, and a happy place to live and find exciting work when they are adults.

They are saying, "We want a fresh start! We want leaders who will really listen to us and build a brighter future for Albania, a future where everyone can shine!" They believe a change in leadership will bring new hope and new ideas.

Did you know? The capital city of Albania is called Tirana. It's a busy and colourful city, full of schools, shops, and homes, where many of these young people live!

The "Horizontal Revolt" – A Special Way to Speak

The grown-up news talks about something called a "Horizontal Revolt." That's a very big name for a simple idea! For us, it just means that many young people, from different towns and different schools, are all speaking up together at the same time. It's not just one special person telling everyone what to do or leading the whole thing. Instead, it's lots and lots of young people feeling the same way and deciding to stand together as friends.

Think of it like a beautiful choir, where many different voices sing one song together to make it stronger and clearer. Each young person is like a voice in that choir, singing for change and for a better tomorrow. When many voices come together, they are much louder!

Did you know? When people work together, like in a choir or a sports team, they can achieve amazing things that one person might not be able to do alone!

No One Bossing Them Around

What's super interesting about these young people in Albania is that they don't have one big "boss" telling them what to do or how to protest. It's not like one special leader is saying, "Everyone follow me!" Instead, many young people feel the same way in their hearts, and they are all deciding together to speak up for their future. They are helping each other, sharing their ideas, and organizing things themselves.

It shows that when many people truly want something, they don't always need one leader to get things going. They can lead themselves by helping each other and working as a team. This kind of teamwork makes their message very powerful.

Did you know? Albania used to be a very closed-off country, but now it's open to the world and its people can travel more freely to see new places and share ideas!

Dreams for a Brighter Future

These young people are not just complaining about things that are not good. They are dreaming big and full of hope! They are dreaming of a country where children go to great schools with lots of exciting things to learn, where there are lots of fun and safe places to play, and where when they grow up, they can find exciting jobs right there in Albania, so they don't have to leave their home.

They want their country to be fair for everyone, no matter who they are. They want to feel proud of their home and know that their ideas matter and can help make things better. Their protests are a way to tell everyone, "We care about Albania, and we want to help make it the best place it can be for all of us!"

Did you know? The flag of Albania has a black double-headed eagle on a bright red background. It's a very striking and famous flag that stands for their brave spirit!

Why Their Voices Matter

It's very important that we listen to young people. They are the future of every country! The children and young adults of today will be the grown-ups who lead the country tomorrow, who build the homes, teach in the schools, and invent new things. When they speak up, they are telling us what kind of world they want to live in, and what kind of country they want to build for themselves and for the children who come after them.

So, even though Albania is far away from Africa, we can learn an important lesson: it's good to listen to everyone, especially the young ones, because they have important things to say about making the world a better place. And it's always best to speak up peacefully and kindly, to make friends, not enemies.

Did you know? Many countries around the world believe that everyone should have the right to speak up and share their opinions peacefully. This is a very important idea called "freedom of speech"!

Our Message to Albania

So, to all the young people in Albania, we hear you! Keep sharing your dreams and working together for a wonderful future. We hope that everyone in Albania can find a way to make their country even more amazing, full of happiness and great opportunities for all!
summary: Young people in the country of Albania are speaking up peacefully because they want their leader to leave and believe new leaders will make their country better for everyone.
whyMatters: This matters because it shows that even young people have important ideas and can work together peacefully to ask for changes that will make their country a happier and fairer place for the future.

originalTitle: Why Rubio is visiting Reliance’s oil refinery in India, the world’s largest
title: Mr. Rubio Visits a Super Big Fuel Factory in India!
content:
Jambo, Amazing Kids of Africa!

Hello, hello, wonderful children! It's your kid-friendly news reporter here, bringing you exciting stories from around our big, beautiful world! Today, we have a very interesting story about a man from a far-away country and a super-duper big factory. Are you ready? Let's go!

Who is Mr. Rubio?

Once upon a time, not really a fairy tale, but a true story! There's a country called America, far, far away across the ocean. In America, there are people who help run the country, just like your teachers help run your school, or your parents help run your home. One of these important people is named **Mr. Rubio**. He is like a special messenger and a helper for America. He travels to different countries to talk to leaders and big companies. He wants to make sure everyone is getting along and that important things, like fuel for our cars, are working well. Did you know? America is a very big country, with many famous places like big cities and tall buildings!

A Trip to India

Mr. Rubio took a long, long flight all the way to a country called **India**. India is another amazing country, full of vibrant colours, delicious foods, and lots of people! It's known for its beautiful temples and fun festivals. Why did Mr. Rubio travel so far? He went to visit a very special place in India. It's a place where magic happens, not the disappearing kind, but the kind that turns gooey, dark oil into clean, useful fuel! Did you know? India is one of the biggest countries in the world, with more than a billion people! That's a lot of friends!

What is Reliance?

The special place Mr. Rubio visited is owned by a company called **Reliance**. Now, Reliance is not just any company; it's a super-duper, extra-large company! Imagine the biggest shop you've ever seen, then make it a hundred times bigger! Reliance has a huge factory, or what we call an **oil refinery**. This refinery is like a giant kitchen where they cook and clean crude oil to make it ready for our cars, buses, and even airplanes! It's actually the biggest oil refinery in the whole wide world! Isn't that amazing? Did you know? "Reliance" means to depend on something or someone. This company helps many people depend on them for fuel!

The Amazing Oil Refinery

So, what exactly is an **oil refinery**? Think of it like a giant washing machine and a cooking pot, all in one! Deep, deep under the ground, we find something called **crude oil**. It's a thick, black liquid, a bit like very muddy water. You can't put this crude oil straight into your car or it will break! So, it goes to the refinery. At the refinery, they heat it up, clean it, and separate it into different parts. Some parts become petrol for cars, some become diesel for big trucks and buses, and other parts become fuel for airplanes! Did you know? Crude oil was formed over millions of years from tiny plants and animals that lived in the sea a very, very long time ago!

Why is Fuel So Important?

Can you imagine a world without cars, buses, or even some lights? It would be very different, right? Fuel, which comes from oil, is like the food for these machines. It helps your mom or dad drive you to school, it helps buses carry many people, and it helps airplanes fly high in the sky to visit faraway places, like Mr. Rubio did! Fuel also helps factories make the clothes you wear and the toys you play with. It even helps farmers use tractors to grow food for us! So, having enough fuel is super important for our daily lives. Did you know? The first cars did not use petrol; some even ran on steam or electricity!

Keeping Fuel Prices Happy

Sometimes, the price of fuel can go up and down. When fuel is very expensive, it means your parents might have to pay more to drive the car, and things in the shops might cost more because it costs more to bring them there. America, and Mr. Rubio, want to help make sure that the price of fuel doesn't get too, too high. They want everyone to be able to afford to travel and to buy the things they need. If there's enough fuel for everyone, the price usually stays happy and not too high. Did you know? When you save electricity by turning off lights, you're also helping save energy resources!

Friends and Problems in the World

Now, here's a part that can be a little bit tricky. Sometimes, countries don't always agree on everything. Just like sometimes you might have a disagreement with a friend, countries can have big disagreements. The news story mentions some big problems in the world, like a "war on Iran." This means some countries are having very serious disagreements. When countries have problems, it can make it harder for everyone to get important things like fuel. America wants to talk to countries like India to find good ways to make sure everyone can still get the fuel they need, even when there are disagreements. They want to encourage countries to buy fuel from many different places, not just one place, especially if that one place is having problems with other countries, like Russia. Did you know? Talking to each other is often the best way to solve problems, whether it's between friends or between countries!

India's Big Role

India, with its giant Reliance refinery, plays a very important role in all of this. Because Reliance can make so much fuel, it can help supply many countries. When Mr. Rubio visits, he's basically saying, "Hey India, you're doing a great job making lots of fuel! Can we all work together to make sure everyone gets enough, and that fuel prices stay fair, especially when some other countries are having big problems?" It's like a big team effort to make the world run smoothly. Did you know? India is also famous for its Bollywood movies, which are full of singing and dancing!

Working Together for a Brighter Future

So, when Mr. Rubio visited the Reliance refinery in India, it wasn't just a trip; it was a mission to help make the world a better place for everyone. It was about making sure that the important fuel we need for our cars, buses, and planes is always available and not too expensive. It was also about countries talking to each other and trying to solve problems together. Just like we learn to share and help each other in our homes and schools, countries also need to learn to share and help each other on a much bigger scale. And that's exactly what Mr. Rubio and India are trying to do! Did you know? Every time you learn something new, you're helping to make our world smarter and better! Keep learning, amazing kids!
summary: A man named Mr. Rubio from America visited a huge factory in India that makes fuel, to talk about making sure everyone has enough fuel and that it's not too expensive because of some problems between countries.
whyMatters: This is important because it helps make sure cars, buses, and planes can keep moving, and the things we buy don't cost too much, especially when countries are not getting along.

originalTitle: What does Celtic's demolition of Hearts mean for Hogh?
title: Celtic's Big Win: Playing Super Without a Star!
content:
Hello, My Little Football Friends!

Hi everyone! It's your friendly African news reporter here, ready to tell you about some super exciting football news! I hope you are all happy and ready to hear about a fantastic game. Today, we are talking about a big football team called Celtic. They play in a country far away called Scotland. But the fun of football is for everyone, everywhere! This story is about how a team can play really, really well even when one of their most important players is not on the field. It's like when you and your friends play together, and sometimes one friend can't come, but you all still have a lot of fun and play great!

A Super Big Win!

Guess what happened? The team Celtic played a game against another team called Hearts. And Celtic won with a super, super big score! They scored 7 goals, and Hearts scored 1 goal. Wow! That’s like getting seven delicious candies and your friend only getting one. It's a very big difference, isn't it? When a team wins by so many goals, we sometimes say they 'demolished' the other team. It doesn't mean they broke anything! It just means they played incredibly well and scored much, much more. They were just too strong on that day.

What Happened in the Game?

Imagine a big green field, with many players running around. The crowd is cheering loudly! Celtic players were all running, passing the ball, and trying their very best. They wanted to score goals for their team and their fans. They worked together like a busy ant colony! Each player knew what to do. They passed the ball from one friend to another, dribbled past their opponents, and took powerful shots towards the goal. It was an exciting game to watch!

Goals, Goals, Goals!

Seven times, the ball went into the back of the net for Celtic! Every time a goal was scored, the fans jumped up and cheered. It was a happy day for Celtic supporters. Scoring so many goals shows how good they were at working together. Did you know? A goal is scored when the whole ball crosses the goal line between the posts and under the crossbar, and no foul has been committed. It’s the most exciting part of football!

What is a 'Record Signing'?

Now, here’s a slightly tricky part, but don't worry, I'll make it simple! Every football team buys players to come and play for them. They pay money to another team to get a player. Sometimes, a team pays a lot, a lot of money for a player because he is super talented and they really want him. When a team pays the most money they have *ever* paid for *any* player, that player is called a 'record signing'. It means he cost more than any other player they ever bought before! Imagine buying the biggest, most special toy you have ever seen. That's a bit like a record signing for a football team!

Playing Without a Star Player

In this big game, Celtic played without their 'record signing'. This means their most expensive and very talented player was not on the field that day. Maybe he was not feeling well, or the coach wanted to give other players a chance to show what they can do. Some people thought, "Oh no! If the most expensive player isn't playing, maybe Celtic won't be as good!" But guess what? They played amazingly well! They showed everyone that they are strong even without that one special player. Why This Game Was Special

This game was special because it proved something important. It showed that a team doesn't just rely on one super-duper player. It showed that *everyone* on the team is important. Every pass, every tackle, every run matters. It was a wonderful example of teamwork. When all the players work together, share the ball, and help each other, they can achieve great things. Even without their most famous player, Celtic played like champions.
